messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Use the reference photo for facial identity, and make the body's skin tone consistent with the target person. Keep the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Use the reference photo for facial identity, and make the body's skin tone consistent with the target person. Keep the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands facing the camera, then turns her head to the side, raises her right hand to touch her face and hair, and finally turns back to face forward with a slight smile.","camera":"Static medium close-up shot from a slightly low angle, keeping the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"A bright pink, off-the-shoulder long-sleeved top with dark purple straps or accents on the shoulders.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Voluminous blue hair styled in a high bun with thick, curved side pieces framing the face.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with fair skin, a slender build, and a stylized face.","scene":"An outdoor, sunlit area resembling a dock or industrial yard with stone paving, wooden crates, planks, and old wooden boats in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's face and visible skin became noticeably fairer and more stylized, with altered facial features and lip color. The blue high-bun hairstyle, pink off-shoulder top, background, camera framing, and overall motion sequence remain essentially the same.
arguments.requested_change: Change the character's facial identity to match the reference person and make the body skin tone consistent with the target, while preserving hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.
uncertain: Whether the new facial identity sufficiently matches the reference photo, since the face is stylized and only partially visible during motion.
unexpected_changes: The character's skin tone became much lighter than the reference person's medium/tan tone, contrary to the instruction to make it consistent with the target.
